summary: The downstream A6 and A7 regression fixtures instantiate pre-v3 free-form draft shapes instead of the frozen v3 typed creative Draft contract. They fail before any projection or dual-loop assertion can execute.

observed_failure.first_failure: TypeError: VisualBeatDraft.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'visual_beat_ordinal'

canonical_v3_contract: VisualBeatDraft requires an explicit sequential visual_beat_ordinal.
ShotDesignDraft requires local-compatible shot_ordinal, DurationIntent, GenerationMode, typed reference_binding_intents, typed dialogue_binding_intents, and creative_notes.
ExecutionDesignDraft accepts only creative transition intents and handoff intent; it does not own timing, fact identity, or free-text binding authority.
stale_fixture_surface: A6/A7 supply duration_weight rather than a typed DurationIntent.
A6/A7 supply free-text audio_intents and reference_intents instead of typed opaque fact-handle bindings.
Those fixtures therefore cannot represent the v3 authority boundary that A5 must compile.

affected_contract: A6 Projection and A7 dual-loop regressions must consume canonical v3 A5 outputs assembled from typed creative drafts; stale test fixtures cannot define, extend, or override that contract.

a5_attempt.reason: The construction protocol prohibits completing or retaining an A5 migration while required cross-package regression evidence contradicts the frozen v3 contract.

required_resolution: At the owning A6/A7 work packages, replace stale fixtures with canonical v3 typed Draft, BlockingCommit, and FactRegistry construction.
Do not restore duration_weight, free-text audio_intents, free-text reference_intents, default timing, or model-supplied machine identities as compatibility shims.
Re-run A6 and A7 registered regressions, then recover and re-execute A5 from the ledger in a new claimed work package.
